resale_co.name: Resale and/or Rental Certificate (RRC)
resale_co.issued_by: River Vale Building Department (Construction Official / Zoning Official), with the Fire Prevention Bureau doing the smoke/CO part
resale_co.lead_time: Fee depends on business days of notice before the inspection: 11 or more business days for the lowest combined fee. Inspections are Monday or Wednesday afternoons or Friday mornings; no specific time can be requested.
requirements: Building inspection for compliance with Township ordinances, including: sealed furnace/boiler flue connections; permitted and inspected water heaters and mechanical equipment; sump pumps discharging outside, not to the sanitary sewer; anti-tip brackets on stoves where required; rigid visible kitchen exhaust ducts; covered outlets, switches, boxes and panels; no lamp cords on fixed appliances
Handrails on 4 or more risers; guards on landings 30 inches above floor or grade and on open basement stairs; sheetrock on garage walls/ceilings next to the house
Pool fence and gate rules (self-closing, self-latching, outward swing, latches 54 inches high); hot tubs need approved latches
No open permits, unpaid fees or property maintenance violations; open permits must be inspected and closed before the RRC inspection
Number of bedrooms and bathrooms must match the current property tax record
Smoke/CO and secondary power source label inspection by the Fire Prevention Bureau
Someone 18 or older must be at the house for the whole inspection window

fees.label: Resale/Rental Certificate, residential, combined building and fire, 11 or more business days notice
fees.quote: $200 - Inspection performed 11 or more business days notice

fees.label: Combined building and fire, 4 to 10 business days notice
Combined building and fire, less than 4 business days notice
fees.quote: $300 - Inspection performed less than 4 business days notice

fees.label: Resale and/or rental certificate, building portion, more than 10 business days before inspection (Township Code 142-27)
fees.quote: Requests made more than 10 business days prior to inspection: $100.

fees.label: Building portion, 4 through 10 business days before inspection
fees.quote: Between four through 10 business days prior to inspection: $125.

fees.label: Building portion, less than 4 business days before inspection
fees.quote: Less than four business days prior to inspection: $150.

resale_co.how_to_apply: Complete the Resale and/or Rental Certificate (RRC) application, leaving nothing blank, and submit it with a check payable to the Township of River Vale (one check can cover both the building and fire inspections). Requests can also be made online through the Township's SDL Portal or by email to inspections@rivervalenj.org. Applications and checks can be dropped in the Town Hall vestibule lockbox at 406 Rivervale Road.
resale_co.contact_title: Zoning & RRC Coordinator / Land Use Administrator

evidence.quote: Please contact Maria Haag 201-664-2346 ext. 1065 for Zoning, Land Use, or Resale/Rental Certificates.
Please make checks payable to the Township of River Vale. One check can be made for both Building and Fire inspections.
All open permits must be closed prior to the sale.
Inspections will be scheduled on Monday or Wednesday afternoons, or Friday mornings.
Certificate of occupancy, resale and/or rental certificates are required before occupancy.

Prior to the rental, transfer of title or occupancy of any dwelling house or houses or any dwelling unit or units provided for in this section, application for a certificate of occupancy, resale and/or rental certificates permitting occupancy shall be made, in writing, to the Construction Official or his agent of the Township
Residential: $100 in addition to fire prevention fees.

resale_co.notes: Township Code Section 142-27 (amended through Ord. 453-2025, March 24, 2025) requires a resale and/or rental certificate before any transfer of title or new occupancy, and was read through a text reader of ecode360. The RRC form's combined residential fees ($200 / $250 / $300) equal the building fee in Section 142-27 ($100 / $125 / $150) plus the Fire Prevention fee in Section 112-12 ($100 / $125 / $150). Section 90-4B (Ord. 409-2023) also lists a residential resale/rental certificate fee of $100 'in addition to fire prevention fees'. Do not add the building and fire rows again; the RRC form total is what a seller pays. Lead-based paint rules in Section 142-27 apply to rental units only. The SDL Portal (sdlportal.com) needs an account.

requirements: Smoke alarms on every level including the basement, within 10 feet of all bedroom doors on sleeping floors; type depends on build/renovation date (battery before 1977, electric for later homes, interconnected with battery backup for March 1991 and later)
Electric alarms cannot be replaced with battery alarms; smoke alarms over 10 years old must be replaced; no Velcro or tape mounting
Two-family homes need a smoke alarm at each landing of common hallways and stairs
Carbon monoxide alarm outside each sleeping area within 10 feet of all bedroom doors (UL 2034, NFPA 720); CO alarms over 5 years old are treated as expired unless the maker documents a longer life
Secondary Power Source Identification Label within 18 inches of the main electric panel and meter if there is a generator, solar panels or battery storage
Low voltage fire alarm systems need an NFPA 72 Report of Inspection from an approved contractor done no more than 30 days before
An agent, owner or representative must be present during the inspection window

authorities.name: River Vale Fire Prevention Bureau
authorities.lead_time: Fee depends on business days between the request and the inspection: more than 10 business days for the lowest fee. The certificate is valid for 6 months from issue unless occupancy or ownership changes first; it is not transferable.

fees.label: Smoke alarm, CO alarm and secondary power source label certificate (CSACMASPSIL), requested more than 10 business days before inspection
fees.quote: Requests made more than ten (10) business days prior to the requested inspection: $100.00

fees.label: Requested 4 to 10 business days before inspection
fees.quote: Requests made four (4) to ten (10) business days prior to the requested inspection: $125.00

fees.label: Requested fewer than 4 business days before inspection
fees.quote: Requests made fewer than four (4) business days prior to the requested inspection: $150.00

fees.label: Penalty for failing to obtain the certificate
fees.quote: Penalty for failure to obtain a Certificate of Smoke Detector and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Secondary Power Source Identification: $500.00

authorities.how_to_apply: Use the Township's Resale and/or Rental Certificate (RRC) application, which schedules both the building and fire inspections; one check payable to the Township of River Vale covers both. Requests can also go through the SDL Portal or inspections@rivervalenj.org.
authorities.contact_title: Fire Marshal (Coordinator: Maria Haag, ext. 1065; Fire Inspector: Danessa Real, ext. 1018)

evidence.quote: A Certificate of Smoke Alarm and Carbon Monoxide Alarm Secondary Power Source Identification Label (CSACMASPSIL) is required before any residential unit is sold, leased or otherwise made subject to change of occupancy for residential purposes.
The CSDCMASPSIL will remain valid for a period of six (6) months from the date of issue unless the occupancy or ownership of the dwelling changes in the interim.
Requests made more than 10 business days prior to inspection: $100.

One- and two-family dwellings that require a Certificate of Smoke Detector & Carbon Monoxide Alarm Compliance for the sale of the property or a change in occupancy are inspected by the Fire Prevention Bureau prior to the issuance of that certificate.
LEAID: 0253-001 Enf Auth. Fire Dept Fire Official David Haenelt Phone (201) 664-2346 Addr: 330 River Vale Rd River Vale NJ 07675 ... Email fireprevention@rivervalenj.org

fire_cert.notes: Fees match Township Code Section 112-12B(1) (read through a text reader of ecode360) and the Bureau's May 2026 requirements sheet. The Bureau's sheet does not list a fire extinguisher, consistent with P.L.2025, c.19. The Fire Prevention page names Fire Marshal David Haenelt (dhaenelt@rivervalenj.org, ext. 1201); the state directory lists fireprevention@rivervalenj.org.

other_items.label: Open permits and unpaid fees
other_items.detail: All open permits must be inspected and closed before the RRC inspection, and there can be no unpaid fees or property maintenance violations.

other_items.label: Bedroom and bathroom count
other_items.detail: The number of bedrooms and bathrooms must match the current property tax record.

other_items.label: Secondary power source label
other_items.detail: Homes with a generator, solar panels or battery storage need a permanent warning label within 18 inches of the main electric panel and meter.
